text:
chris: alert: hosted-ap-southeast-1 GPU pool headroom fell to ~0.5% over the last 8m, admission control started returning 503s for free-tier traffic :warning:
maya: seeing the same on the dashboard — p95 admission latency jumping from 120ms -> 2.4s, queued requests spiking to ~1.2k
chris: dashboard link: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/pool-capacity?region=ap-southeast-1 (headroom chart on the right)
jamie: any recent deploys into that region?
maya: nothing obvious, no model rollouts. infra autoscaler logs show a lot of failed node joins/warmups in last 10m
lina: digging into node events — image pull failures and kubelet timeouts on new nodes. suspect registry throttling during warmup. logs:
```
Kubelet: Failed to pull image "registry.int.redwood/runtime:gpu-v1.4": error response from registry: 429 Too Many Requests
container_start: Back-off pulling image
```
chris: ah, that would prevent new nodes from becoming ready -> autoscaler thinks it's failed and keeps removing, net effect = no added capacity
jamie: queueing backlog then fills admission queues. can we temporarily route traffic to dedicated capacity?
maya: yes we can flip routing policy but need approvals for bumping dedicated usage for a short window (cost impact). ops-bot, is there a cheap routing knob?
ops-bot: suggest: 1) enable fallback to global-burst pool for low-priority traffic, 2) increase warmup parallelism (image pull concurrency), 3) open incident ticket for registry throttling.
chris: implemented fallback to global-burst (manual routing rule), monitoring effect now
lina: increased image pull concurrency on the warmup job from 10 -> 30, and added exponential backoff retry for registry 429s.
maya: nice — headroom moving up slowly, p95 admissions down to ~600ms
jamie: also queued a change to image pull strategy: add local cache priming during scale-ups to avoid hitting registry at scale. will open PR.
chris: opened incident (#INC-2021) and pinged registry provider. also adding a dashboard alert for node warmup failure rate > 5/min
lina: for next steps: short-term mitigation done (routing + concurrency), medium: cache priming + backoff, long: work with registry to raise rate limits or mirror images to region-local registry.
maya: can someone post a short RCA once registry responds? want to capture the warmup->autoscaler loop in runbook
jamie: will draft RCA, add timeline + command snippets for emergency fallback routing
chris: thanks all — keeping thread open until stable, will update when last 503 clears :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy status: no pending infra deploys to ap-southeast-1
maya: last update (10m): admission p95 220ms, queued requests 140, headroom ~8% — moving to resolved in 15m if stable
chris: closing note: primary root cause = registry rate-limit during mass warmup causing failed node readiness -> autoscaler churn -> pool saturation. mitigation steps recorded in incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
